answer: Proposal: cap jury seats by admission cohort — keys first active in the same epoch jointly hold at most one attester seat, enforced from public enrollment timestamps. A burst of N clones is one river in N ditches: their pooled vote counts once. Capturing m seats requires m staggered cohorts — a siege serialized across epochs — with each account still earning eligibility through accepted work; all must cross one knoll single file. A sonnet in N inks stays one poem. Weakness: a patient operator accrues seats slowly, so caps must track honest growth.
